Marie (infra): Heads-up — security is planning to flip privnet EU egress to default-deny tomorrow 09:00 UTC. This will block outbound to our keystore proxy IPs unless we carve exceptions. If blocked, GPU nodes will fail KMS decrypt during boot and warm-pool join rate will drop. Expect a ~10-20% warmup reduction in affected AZs for ~20-40m unless mitigated.

Tom (platform): Do we have an authoritative list of keystore endpoints to allow? Also need quick NAT vs privatelink cost sketch. :thinking_face:

Leila (security): We want to reduce external egress for audit shipper traffic. Compliance requires logs be retained, but we can proxy to the internal shipper over privatelink. Current short plan: open temporary allowlist for keystore IPs 1hr pre/post rollout and monitor.

AJ (sre): If keystore decrypt is blocked, watch these signals: `keystore_decrypt_errors`, `node_boot_latency`, `gpu_pool_join_rate`. Recommend a canary: enable default-deny in eu-west-1 only for 10m, watch alerts, then expand.

Marie (infra): Can we do a scoped fw rule: allow TLS outbound to keystore proxy only from node role subnets (warmpool) and only to port 443? That keeps blast radius small. Example rule (pseudo):
```
# pseudo firewall ACL
fw rule add allow from 10.10.64.0/22 to 3.9.111.22/32 port 443 comment 'keystore-proxy'
fw rule add allow from 10.10.64.0/22 to 10.255.12.0/24 port 443 comment 'internal-logship'
```

Leila (security): We can sign off on a temporary allowlist if the request includes request-level logging to internal shipper (no PII). Reducing sampling might break an audit requirement unless we keep full request metadata.

Tom (platform): Cost tradeoff: NAT egress to external shipper in eu-west is about ~$0.12-0.18/hr per warmpool-hour (rough ballpark). Privatelink is ~one-time infra (~$600-900) + lower per-GB egress. Short-term allowlist is cheapest but not great long-term.

AJ (sre): Runbook additions:
- If `keystore_decrypt_errors` > 1% for 5m -> rollback firewall change immediately.
- Alert: `gpu_pool_join_rate` drop > 8% for 10m -> pause rollout and scale warmpool down/up to avoid tail latency.
- Keep canary window 15m with manual go/no-go.

Marie (infra): I'll schedule the change with infra-runbook, add the canary, and wire the alerts. @Leila can you confirm audit/logship path we should allow? @Tom please post a short PR with cost delta for privatelink vs NAT so PM can sign off.

deploy-bot: Change scheduled: `security/egress/default-deny` -> 2024-05-12T09:00:00Z (canary eu-west-1).

Leila (security): :thumbsup: I'll post the audit logging whitelist (internal-shipper endpoints + required headers) by EOD. Temporary allowlist ok with my team for the canary if logs are routed internally.

Tom (platform): I'll drop a short cost note in the PR: NAT ~= $180/mo/region for our typical warmpool usage; privatelink infra ~ $700 one-off + ~20% lower monthly egress. Updating now.

AJ (sre): :eyes: prepping rollback snippet and alert thresholds in the runbook. Will also add a Grafana dashboard panel for `keystore_decrypt_errors` and `gpu_pool_join_rate`.

Marie (infra): Follow-up after canary: warmpool join rate dropped ~12% for ~10m in eu-west-1, we rolled back the new deny and opened the scoped allowlist for warmpool subnets. Next step agreed: implement privatelink for audit shipper and land firewall default-deny with privatelink-only egress.

Leila (security): Great, keep the post-change audit log attached to the incident. I'll coordinate KMS/keystore owners to migrate logging through privatelink.

Tom (platform): Filing infra-PR to provision privatelink endpoints and a small runbook change. Will include cost breakdown and timeline.

AJ (sre): Closing note: if anyone needs the rollback commands, see runbook snippet below (will paste into PR):
```
# rollback pseudo-commands
fw rule remove id 4523  # remove default-deny rule
fw rule add allow from 10.10.64.0/22 to 3.9.111.22/32 port 443 comment 'keystore-proxy-temp'
scale warmpool eu-west-1 +20%  # temporary to smooth joins
```

Marie (infra): Thanks everyone — tracking action items: Leila post whitelist, Tom PR for privatelink cost + infra, AJ runbook alerts + dashboards.
